an4.172:3.2: In many ways I explain, teach, assert, establish, clarify, analyze, and reveal it.
an4.172:3.3: Whoever has any doubt or uncertainty, let them ask me,
an4.172:3.4: I will answer. Our teacher is present, he who is so very skilled in our teachings.
